guard: cotal space lists the registered spaces with each broker's state and never dials a discovered one, space show gives one in full without its credential path, cotal use selects any registered space without probing it and refuses an unregistered name, and a command run under the selection targets it when its broker is down and refuses a selection that names no registration
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/space-reads.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary against a real broker, a dead port and a listener that counts dials, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The resolver entries restore the old behavior, where a selected space whose broker was down, or one no longer registered, let the command reach another mesh.

mutations.name: a broker that does not answer lists as reachable
mutations.expectRed: a broker that does not answer reads as unreachable and keeps its registration
mutations.cell: a broker that does not answer reads as unreachable and keeps its registration

mutations.name: the listing checks a discovered space
mutations.expectRed: a discovered space is not checked and keeps its catalog name
mutations.cell: a discovered space is not checked and keeps its catalog name

mutations.name: show dials a discovered space's broker
mutations.expectRed: show never dials a discovered space's broker
mutations.cell: show never dials a discovered space's broker

mutations.name: show copies the whole user-auth record
mutations.find: userAuth: m.userAuth ? { provider: m.userAuth.provider, idp: { ...m.userAuth.idp }, remote: m.userAuth.remote === true } : null,
mutations.replace: userAuth: m.userAuth ? { ...m.userAuth, remote: m.userAuth.remote === true } : null,
mutations.expectRed: show leaves the credential path out
mutations.cell: show leaves the credential path out

mutations.name: bare show ignores the selection
mutations.expectRed: bare show shows the selected space
mutations.cell: bare show shows the selected space

mutations.name: a dangling selection gets no warning
mutations.find: if (result.current === null || result.currentRecorded || result.prepared.some((p) => p.current)) return [];
mutations.replace: if (result.current === null || result.currentRecorded || result.prepared.some((p) => p.current) || result.items.length > 0) return [];
mutations.expectRed: a selection that names no registration is reported with a warning
mutations.cell: a selection that names no registration is reported with a warning

mutations.name: use selects an unregistered name
mutations.find: if (!m && !p) throw new CommandFailure("refused", "TARGET_NOT_FOUND", `no space named "${name}" is registered here`, { remedy: "see the registered spaces with `cotal space`" });
mutations.expectRed: use refuses an unregistered name with TARGET_NOT_FOUND and keeps the selection
mutations.cell: use refuses an unregistered name with TARGET_NOT_FOUND and keeps the selection

mutations.name: selecting the selected space again is reported as a change
mutations.expectRed: selecting the selected space again is a no-op
mutations.cell: selecting the selected space again is a no-op

mutations.name: a selected space whose broker is down is skipped
mutations.expectRed: a command run with the selected space down refuses with TARGET_UNAVAILABLE naming its broker
mutations.cell: a command run with the selected space down refuses with TARGET_UNAVAILABLE naming its broker

mutations.name: a selection that names no registration falls through
mutations.expectRed: a command run under that selection refuses with TARGET_NOT_FOUND rather than reaching another space
mutations.cell: a command run under that selection refuses with TARGET_NOT_FOUND rather than reaching another space

mutations.name: the refusal for a dangling selection loses its remedy
mutations.expectRed: the refusal tells how to select a registered space
mutations.cell: the refusal tells how to select a registered space
